facts.text: At Southwest Baptist University, all full-time degree-seeking undergraduate students on the Bolivar campus are required to attend a minimum of 75% of the Chapel services offered during the semester.

sources.title: Chapel and Discipleship | Southwest Baptist University
sources.quote: All full-time, degree-seeking undergraduate students on the Bolivar campus are expected to attend Chapel during their time at SBU. Students are required to attend a minimum of 75% of the Chapel services offered during the semester.
